name: La Trepadora
overview: Nicolás del Casal is a descendant of the former owners of Cantarrana, the hacienda where his half-uncle, Hilario Guanipa, and his family have been living. Nicolás, who grew up in Europe, returns to Venezuela to rediscover his past and also recover the property that his father, Jaimito del Casal, lost one day. Already in his native country, Nicolás will meet his half-cousin, Victoria Guanipa, Hilario's daughter. Victoria is a strong and ambitious woman who lives to show the world that she was born to rule, but she is also sweet and naive. Raised in the safety of Cantarrana, Nicolás's arrival in Caracas represents an internal conflict for her, since she feels that she is no longer the only one on the hacienda, but just one more.
